svg.title: Sliding a 3×3 edge kernel over a 6×6 image
svg.desc: A 6×6 image whose left three columns are 10 and right three are 0. The 3×3 kernel with rows 1, 0, -1 sits on rows 1 to 3, columns 2 to 4. The nine products sum to 30, which fills output cell row 1, column 2 of the 4×4 output. Every output row is 0, 30, 30, 0.

g.text: bias 0, so the output cell is 30
